finding.claim: defu is cast to DefuInstance which requires fn/arrayFn/extend but the implementation never assigns them, so defu.fn, defu.arrayFn and defu.extend are undefined at runtime.
finding.title: defu instance missing fn/arrayFn/extend implementations
